id: title:EDsCODE:scope register data imports workflow id per generation

observations.behavior: Adds deterministic token derivation for legacy folder names while preserving unique tokens for timestamped folders.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes workflow ID construction in DuckLake data import registration; could prevent collisions between multiple registrations of different query generations.

observations.behavior: Replaces static workflow IDs with those including the preparation folder's generation suffix.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows distinguishing separate ingestion runs that produce distinct query-ready folders within one warehouse sync job.

observations.behavior: Adds tests asserting generated workflow IDs differ across prepared generations but remain stable per identical input.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression checks and documentation of expected behavior without changing implementation or tier.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks reviewed. No runtime execution or end-to-end test results are available to confirm actual collision prevention or recovery behavior.

review.limitations: Only three hunks reviewed. No runtime execution or end-to-end test results are available to confirm actual collision prevention or recovery behavior.
review.reason: The change introduces a bounded correctness improvement: it distinguishes workflow instances by query-generation metadata rather than only by team/job identifiers. This reduces false-positive WorkflowAlreadyStartedError handling and supports correct re-registration after redelivery. Tests support this, but no broader systemic risk reduction is demonstrated.
review.posthog_relevance: Affects DuckLake registration workflows for warehouse data imports; relevant to reliability and consistency of warehouse-side ingestion.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on static inspection; cannot verify production behavior or complete coverage of related paths.
